wins: Completed reconnaissance phase without triggering alarms, capturing initial service banners and open ports for subsequent exploitation.
Maintained consistent reward accumulation (60.00) across the episode despite not achieving overall success, indicating controlled symptom management.
fails: Final objective unmet; payload delivery/privilege escalation attempt failed, resulting in 0% success rate.
Mentor assistance required 10 times, highlighting gaps in autonomous decisioning during exploitation stages.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was effective, but exploitation/exfiltration phases repeatedly faltered; focus next on automating reliable exploitation chains and reducing mentor dependency.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Payload deployment aborted after SSH enumeration due to incorrect exploit selection or configuration error.
